$comment: Input profile for the M0 load baseline. This file records HOW the baseline is measured, not the measured result: results belong in docs/LOAD-BASELINE.md (owned by another lane). tools/check-test-assets.py fails if these parameters drift from server/internal/match/bench_test.go.
rules: measure on an otherwise idle host; record CPU count and Go version
never weaken the assertion to make a number look better
a regression is a signal to investigate, not a reason to delete the test
